summary: Firefox’s DOM core received broad maintenance and standards work: Feature-Policy is now Permissions-Policy using the Structured Fields Value (SFV) parser, referrer policies and XML language attributes are handled more correctly, and CSS skew transforms, popovers, shadow roots, custom elements, MathML anchors, and Container Timing gained or improved support. Selection, focus navigation, ranges, dialogs, directionality, idle callbacks, mutation observers, and animation flushing were made more reliable and efficient, including better behavior across shadow DOM and flattened trees. Security and platform hardening also improved around embedded content, PDF.js, service workers, IndexedDB corruption, screen orientation, and drag handling; Firefox now warns when AI Controls block speech recognition.
